field.name: help
field.p: Use the professional timeline view to manage staff assignments with drag & drop functionality. Group by staff members and easily reschedule assignments by dragging them to new time slots.

ul.li: Click on the UNASSIGNED row at a specific date/time to create a new unassigned assignment
Or switch to List view (icon in top-right) and click the "New" button
The booking order (FSO) will be automatically filled in
Leave "Assigned Staff" empty to create an unassigned assignment
Drag the assignment card to a staff row to assign them
